name: mcp-abap-adt
description: MCP server for ABAP ADT in SAP ECC/S/4HANA (on-premise) and SAP BTP ABAP Cloud systems: CRUD of ABAP, DDIC, CDS and RAP objects, where-used, ATC, unit tests, transports, the ABAP and AMDP debugger, abapGit, MCP prompts and access restrictions, the data tools off by default. Twelve binaries, from eighteen packages: the full, compact and read-only tool sets over stdio (destinations and logins; SAP over HTTP, RFC or SNC), Streamable HTTP or HTTP+SSE (credentials from x-sap-* headers)
